title: A PR that changes the mutation harness runs a CI-sized mutate-guard run before it joins a batch
why: Coordinator mistake, 06:18 CST Nov 9 (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard): #1597 was pulled into batch 68 to raise the mutate-guard cap, but it also changed the mutation harness (a clean-layout control), which timed out on every target in CI: 670 of 694 unknown, run 42620238014. No check runs a PR that changes hooks/mutate_*.py through a CI-sized checks-mutate-guard before it joins a batch.
note: Fix: when a PR touches hooks/mutate_*.py, the merge tool's lane lint (or the PR's own dispatch run) runs checks-mutate-guard on the PR head and reports its time and unknown count. Red case first. Filed 07:23 CST Nov 9. Related: steps lane-lint-checks-from-batch and lane-lint-cheap-checks-first. Page item 463 (mutate-harness-lane-run, 09:03 CST Nov 9): may a lane that touches hooks/mutate_*.py run the mutation job's command, against ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job? #2443 held until it is answered. Owner pick on the waiting page (13:09 CST Nov 9): item 463 a. Ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job gains one named exception: for a lane that changes the mutation harness, its own suite is the mutation job, run before the batch. #2443 is released with its decision edit.
